purpose: Teach: 激戦/欠損/直観/天災/幻覚/無期/呪縛/避妊

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、激戦地での野戦医療を医療チームで参照します
lines.en: Ren — we handle field medicine in disaster zones as a coordinated medical team.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Even delivery. Clinical precision without coldness. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone explaining institutional practice with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、欠損患部の再建外科を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — reconstructive surgery for trauma injuries is handled by our team.
lines.style: Affirmative nod in the voice. Still measured. Slight emphasis on 「team」— reinforcing collective competence. Warm enough to invite confidence without losing professionalism.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 臨床の直観を、貴院、データで裏付けされますね、先生
lines.en: So clinical intuition here — your hospital backs it up with data, doesn't it, sensei.
lines.style: Thoughtful, not quite a question. Respectful phrasing with genuine curiosity underneath. Slight pause before 「sensei」 — acknowledging hierarchy while engaging as an intellectual equal.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、天災時の救急医療を医療チームで備えております
lines.en: Yes — we're prepared for emergency medicine in disaster situations as a coordinated team.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Slight emphasis on preparedness. The assurance of someone who has thought through scenarios. Not rushed. Shoulders steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 幻覚を訴える患者さんへの治療を、貴院、慎重にされてますね、先生
lines.en: And for patients reporting hallucinations — your hospital approaches that treatment very carefully, doesn't it, sensei.
lines.style: Genuine inquiry with respect underneath. Slight lift at the end — not aggressive, but testing her openness. The cadence of someone asking something that matters to him personally.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、無期療養の患者さんへの長期ケアを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — we provide long-term care for patients in prolonged recovery as a team.
lines.style: Patient, steady. The tone of someone describing care as an ongoing commitment, not a transaction. Slight softening on 「long-term」 — acknowledging the weight of it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 心の呪縛から解放するセラピーを、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital offers therapy to help people free themselves from emotional wounds, doesn't it, sensei.
lines.style: Reflective, almost wondering. Respectful. The phrasing is careful — he's asking about something tender. Slight breathiness, like he's checking if this is safe ground. Slow pace.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、避妊指導を医療チームで丁寧に行います
lines.en: Yes — we provide thorough contraceptive counseling as part of our team's care.
lines.style: Patient, clear, and straightforward. No hesitation or euphemism. The matter-of-fact warmth of someone who doesn't shame. Close proximity in the voice — intimate without being inappropriate.
